nom: Peter Thomas Roth Even Clearer Max Complexion Correction Pads

segments.oily: Reviewers who describe their skin as oily, including one who calls hers the oiliest she knows, report the pads leave their face feeling clean without excess oil, with less breaking out, tighter-looking pores, and a visible glow after a few weeks.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who identifies her skin as dry reports the pads did not dry her face out, unlike the drying many other reviewers describe.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: one in her 20s with combination/oily skin broke out badly after a single use, while another in her mid-40s with combination/oily skin calls it the best her skin has ever looked, and a third recommends pairing it with a moisturizer to offset the dryness.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including one with eczema, say the pads cleared their skin without problems once they scaled back to a few times a week, though one reviewer explicitly warns against the product for sensitive or easily-dried-out skin.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who calls her skin normal reports a single use left her face severely burned, extremely dry, and covered in new pimples in areas she had never broken out before.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s report the pads brighten their skin, reduce oiliness, refine enlarged pores, and even out tone, with one crediting it for looking younger than her age.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers credit the pads with anti-aging benefits and say they look younger than their age or that their skin has never looked better in their 40s, though none describe a specific effect on fine lines or wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Dryness is the single most common side effect reported: many reviewers say it leaves skin dry, tight, or flaky unless paired with a heavy moisturizer and used only every other day or a few times a week, and a couple describe more severe reactions including skin dry enough to crack or bleed; roughly as many others, including some with oily or dry skin, report no drying at all, especially with light or infrequent use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report serious reactions, including burning, redness, and patches that persisted long after they stopped using the product in one case, and in another a severe allergic-type reaction with facial swelling that required urgent care; other reviewers, by contrast, say regular use reduced their redness and evened out uneven skin tone.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report the pads fade post-inflammatory marks, dark spots, and hyperpigmentation with continued use, sometimes paired with a vitamin C serum for extra brightening; one reviewer, however, notes that even after her acne cleared she was still looking for a separate product for the post-acne discoloration.
concerns.blemishes: The great majority of reviewers, including many with hormonal, cystic, or adult acne, report significantly clearer skin, fewer and less painful breakouts, and blemishes that heal faster or shrink overnight with regular use; a smaller number, however, say it did nothing, made their acne dramatically worse after a single use, or stopped working as well after a recent packaging and formula change.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the pads leave oily skin feeling less greasy and looking less shiny with regular use, without any reviewers in this set describing increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Pricey, but reviewers say worth it

extraits.texte: I wish I never used this product. I consider my skin normal & had very minimal breakouts on my jaw line. With simply one use whatever skin the medicated pad touch became extremely irritated. I went to sleep & woke up in the middle of the night to my face severely burnt & with hundreds of tiny pimples on my entire face, including areas I've never broken out at. A week later I'm now left with a severe burn mark throughout my entire face & skin beyond textured. And top of that my skin is extremely dry, no amount of moisturizer has been able to help. Just save yourself all the trouble.

I don't have sensitive skin, but I did have acne. I bought these pads regularly and had been using them for close to a year. On days when I forget to use them, I started to develop these big red patches - I could pick them off but it would only make it worse. At that point, only I use the pads is when the patches go away. It's like my skin had a dependency to it. Anyway, I think it has to do with such potent ingredients/acids that it dried my skin out to the point of being irritated. It took a long time to figure out that it was this product in my routine that was the culprit, and when I completely stopped using it, I had a long purge period that included redness and patches. I still have that redness today, and I bought these at least 5 yrs ago. I would be wary of using this; it's very strong stuff and can damage your skin.

extraits.titre: Excellent for my SUPER oily skin!
extraits.texte: I decided to try these out after I started developing hormonal acne from stopping my birth control. I have the oiliest skin of anyone I know AND I live in Florida so my face is basically a swamp. I honestly didn't have much hope, but I was pleasantly surprised! These REALLY made my face feel squeaky clean after washing and I haven't had any irritation or dryness. I did swap out my previous toner for these so I'm not over drying and I use both hyaluronic acid and a night moisturizer after. After a few weeks of using them, I have found that I'm breaking out significantly less and when I do break out, it doesn't last nearly as long. My pores also appear tighter and my skin looks like it glows now!!! The only con I personally have (and why I didn't give 5 stars) is they have SO much peach scent to them that it makes my eyes water. They don't smell bad the just smell intense. If I could buy a half scented one, I would.
This has helped my hormonal acne especially on my chin. I have dry skin and this product did not dry my face. The scent is good. Also great for blackheads on my nose!
This product is great, it can be harsh but just use it twice a week. Great exfoliate for oily skin with dark spots. My skin is smoother and much brighter, love the smell.

I'm 45 yo with combo/oily skin. I struggle with congested pores and agong skinfo. I started using this product for the glycolic acid content. I've kept using the pads for over 1.5 years because they are great! You need to work your way to daily use but I've never had better skin! I use bronzing powder only now because I don't need to "cover" anything.

These are a game changer. Oh the glow you have after just one use! I have extremely sensitive skin and eczema, these are just wonderful especially for pores and acne. (my pores aren't very big to begin with.)
